license_required.quote: Only a person certified under section sixty-six hundred eight-b of this article or exempt pursuant to section sixty-six hundred ten of this article shall practice registered dental assisting.

issuing_authority.quote: Admission to practice of a profession in this state is accomplished by a license being issued to a qualified applicant by the education department.

name.quote: Admission to practice of a profession in this state is accomplished by a license being issued to a qualified applicant by the education department.

type.quote: The commissioner and the department shall administer the admission to and the practice of the professions.

umbrella_agency.value: Board of Regents, University of the State of New York
umbrella_agency.quote: Admission to the practice of the professions (licensing) and regulation of such practice shall be supervised by the board of regents and administered by the education department, assisted by a state board for each profession.

age_minimum.quote: Age: be at least eighteen years of age

moral_character_required.quote: Character: be of good moral character as determined by the department.

degree_required.value: High school diploma or equivalent, plus approved one-year course of study in dental assisting (including at least 200 hours clinical experience) or alternate course with at least 1,000 hours relevant work experience
degree_required.quote: have received a high school diploma, or its equivalent, and have successfully completed, in accordance with the commissioner's regulations, (i) an approved one-year course of study in dental assisting in a degree-granting institution or a board of cooperative educational services program which includes at least two hundred hours of clinical experience, or an equivalent approved course of study in dental assisting in a non-degree granting institution which shall not be a professional association or professional organization or (ii) an alternate course of study in dental assisting acceptable to the department which shall be provided by a degree-granting institution or a board of cooperative educational services program which includes at least one thousand hours of relevant work experience

required.quote: Only a person certified under section sixty-six hundred eight-b of this article or exempt pursuant to section sixty-six hundred ten of this article shall practice registered dental assisting.

available.quote: Indorse a license issued by a licensing board of another state or country upon the applicant fulfilling the following requirements

requirements.value: Application, education, experience, examination, age (21+), citizenship/immigration status, and good moral character requirements must be met per commissioner's regulations.
requirements.quote: Indorse a license issued by a licensing board of another state or country upon the applicant fulfilling the following requirements: (a) Application: file an application with the department; (b) Education: meet educational requirements in accordance with the commissioner's regulations; (c) Experience: have experience satisfactory to the board and in accordance with the commissioner's regulations; (d) Examination: pass an examination satisfactory to the board and in accordance with the commissioner's regulations; (e) Age: be at least twenty-one years of age; (f) Citizenship or immigration status: be a United States citizen or a noncitizen lawfully admitted for permanent residence in the United States; (g) Character: be of good moral character as determined by the department

exists.quote: A state board for dentistry shall be appointed by the board of regents on recommendation of the commissioner for the purpose of assisting the board of regents and the department on matters of professional licensing and professional conduct

name.quote: A state board for dentistry shall be appointed by the board of regents on recommendation of the commissioner

authority.value: Assists the board of regents and the department on matters of professional licensing and professional conduct; includes at least one registered dental assistant licensed in this state for at least one year.
authority.quote: for the purpose of assisting the board of regents and the department on matters of professional licensing and professional conduct in accordance with section sixty-five hundred eight of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing the profession fraudulently, beyond its authorized scope, with gross incompetence, gross negligence, or negligence/incompetence on more than one occasion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession fraudulently, beyond its authorized scope, with gross incompetence, with gross negligence on a particular occasion or negligence or incompetence on more than one occasion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing while ability is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession while the ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental disability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being habitually drunk or dependent on or habitual user of narcotics, barbiturates, amphetamines, hallucinogens, or similar drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being habitually drunk or being dependent on, or a habitual user of narcotics, barbiturates, amphetamines, hallucinogens, or other drugs having similar effects

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a crime under New York, federal, or another jurisdiction's law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of committing an act constituting a crime under: (i) New York State law or, (ii) Federal law or, (iii) The law of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found guilty of improper professional practice or professional misconduct by a duly authorized professional disciplinary agency of another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found guilty of improper professional practice or professional misconduct by a duly authorized professional disciplinary agency of another state where the conduct upon which the finding was based would, if committed in New York state, constitute professional misconduct under the laws of New York state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to provide professional service to a person because of race, creed, color, or national origin
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to provide professional service to a person because of such person's race, creed, color, or national origin

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting, aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting, aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing while the license is suspended, or willfully failing to register or notify the department of name/address change
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession while the license is suspended, or wilfully failing to register or notify the department of any change of name or mailing address

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing unprofessional conduct as defined by the board of regents or commissioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing unprofessional conduct, as defined by the board of regents in its rules or by the commissioner in regulations approved by the board of regents

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of infection control coursework requirements under section 6505-b
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of section six thousand five hundred five-b of this chapter by a professional other than a professional subject to the provisions of paragraph (f) of subdivision one of section twenty-eight hundred five-k of the public health law.

definition_quote.value: The practice of registered dental assisting is defined as providing supportive services to a dentist in such dentist's performance of dental services authorized under this article.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of registered dental assisting is defined as providing supportive services to a dentist in such dentist's performance of dental services authorized under this article.

value: taking preliminary medical histories and vital signs to be reviewed by the dentist
removing orthodontic arch wires and ligature ties
taking impressions for study casts or diagnostic casts
such other dental supportive services authorized by the dentist consistent with regulations promulgated by the commissioner
methods_authorized.quote: providing patient education, taking preliminary medical histories and vital signs to be reviewed by the dentist, placing and removing rubber dams, selecting and prefitting provisional crowns, selecting and prefitting orthodontic bands, removing orthodontic arch wires and ligature ties, placing and removing matrix bands, taking impressions for study casts or diagnostic casts, removing periodontal dressings, placing and removing temporary restorations, application of topical fluoride varnish, and such other dental supportive services authorized by the dentist consistent with regulations promulgated by the commissioner

assistant_license_type.quote: Only a person certified pursuant to section sixty-six hundred eight-b of this article shall use the title "registered dental assistant".

supervision_level_required.quote: provided that such functions are performed under the direct personal supervision of a licensed dentist in the course of the performance of dental services
